about.metaDescription: Learn about 吳語辭林's mission, content licensing policy, and technical stack. We are building an open, inclusive, and sustainable Wu Chinese dictionary platform.
about.title: About 吳語辭林
about.subtitle: Open Wu Chinese Dictionary Collection Platform - an open Wu Chinese dictionary platform
about.missionP1: 吳語辭林 is building a practical, modern Wu Chinese dictionary platform that helps preserve and share Wu Chinese through contemporary technology.
about.missionP2: By bringing together Wu Chinese dictionaries from multiple sources, we provide learners, researchers, and language enthusiasts with one convenient and comprehensive lookup tool.
about.licenseIntro: The dictionaries collected on this platform broadly fall into two groups, each with its own licensing terms and usage restrictions:

published.title: Published dictionaries
published.examples: Examples include 《寧波方言詞典》 (Tang Zhenzhu et al.), 《上海方言詞典》 (Xu Baohua & Tao Huan), and other volumes of 《現代漢語方言大詞典》. Catalogue entries may be PDF-only; this app imports machine-readable community lexicons first.
published.copyright: These dictionary contents are protected by the Copyright Law of the People's Republic of China. The data comes from publicly shared scanned resources found online.
published.disclaimer: The original book authors are responsible for the entry content. This platform's data was produced through OCR at scale, so recognition or formatting errors may remain. If you find a problem, please open a GitHub issue:
published.limit3: Not for formal publication or product release
published.supportOriginal: We encourage users to support the original sources. If you need to use these dictionary contents formally, please buy the original publication or contact the publisher for permission.

community.title: Community dictionaries
community.intro: These dictionaries are written and maintained by open communities under open licenses.
community.disclaimer: Content disclaimer: entries in community dictionaries are written and maintained by their respective editorial communities. This site only aggregates and displays the content, and does not guarantee its accuracy, completeness, or suitability. If you have questions about a specific entry, please visit the source dictionary site or contact its editors directly.
